claims.quote: Nicaragua will ask for admission to our Union after the completion of the great canal.
claims.description: Nicaragua is predicted to petition to join the United States after a canal is built through it.

claims.quote: The American will be Taller by from one to two inches.
claims.description: Americans are predicted to grow one to two inches taller through better health.

claims.quote: The city house will practically be no more.
claims.description: Most people are predicted to live in suburban homes rather than city houses.

claims.quote: The trip from suburban home to office will require a few minutes only.
claims.description: Commuting from suburb to downtown office is predicted to take only minutes, by fast transit.

claims.quote: Spelling by sound will have been adopted, first by the newspapers.
claims.description: English spelling is predicted to be reformed so words are spelled as they sound.

claims.quote: Hot or cold air will be turned on from spigots to regulate the temperature of a house as we now turn on hot or cold water from spigots to regulate the temperature of the bath.
claims.description: Houses are predicted to be heated and cooled by piped-in air delivered from central plants, like running water.

claims.quote: Food will be served hot or cold to private houses in pneumatic tubes or automobile wagons.
claims.description: Prepared meals are predicted to be delivered to homes from central kitchens through pneumatic tubes or motor vehicles.

claims.quote: Every river or creek with any suitable fall will be equipped with water-motors, turning dynamos, making electricity.
claims.description: Waterwheels on every river and creek are predicted to generate electricity for the whole country.

claims.quote: These underground or overhead streets will teem with capacious automobile passenger coaches and freight wagons, with cushioned wheels.
claims.description: City traffic is predicted to move in underground or elevated roadways carrying large motor vehicles.

claims.quote: If there be a battle in China a hundred years hence snapshots of its most striking events will be published in the newspapers an hour later.
claims.description: Photographs of distant battles are predicted to be sent by wire and printed in newspapers within an hour.

claims.quote: Trains will run two miles a minute, normally ; express trains one hundred and fifty miles an hour.
claims.description: Trains are predicted to run at 120 miles per hour normally and 150 miles per hour on express service.

claims.quote: To go from New York to San Francisco will take a day and a night by fast express.
claims.description: Coast-to-coast rail travel is predicted to take about a day and a night.

claims.quote: There will be cigar-shaped electric locomotives hauling long trains of cars.
claims.description: Trains are predicted to be pulled by streamlined electric locomotives.

claims.quote: Automobiles will have been substituted for every horse vehicle now known.
claims.description: Motor vehicles are predicted to replace every horse-drawn vehicle in use.

claims.quote: Fast electric ships, crossing the ocean at more than a mile a minute, will go from New York to Liverpool in two days.
claims.description: Electric ships are predicted to cross the Atlantic at over 60 miles per hour, in two days.

claims.quote: The bodies of these ships will be built above the waves.
claims.description: Ships are predicted to ride on air-film runners that lift their hulls above the water.

claims.quote: They will be maintained as deadly warvessels by all military nations.
claims.description: Airships are predicted to be kept by every military power as deadly warships.

claims.quote: Giant guns will shoot twenty-five miles or more, and will hurl anywhere within such a radius shells exploding and destroying whole cities.
claims.description: Long-range guns are predicted to destroy entire cities within a twenty-five-mile radius.

claims.quote: Fleets of air-ships, hiding themselves with dense, smoky mists, thrown off by themselves as they move, will float over cities, fortifications, camps or fleets.
claims.description: Airship fleets are predicted to hide inside self-generated smoke screens while bombarding cities and armies.

claims.quote: Huge forts on wheels will dash across open spaces at the speed of express trains of to-day.
claims.description: Armored fortresses on wheels are predicted to cross battlefields at express-train speed.

claims.quote: Great automobile plows will dig deep intrenchments as fast as soldiers can occupy them.
claims.description: Motorized plows are predicted to dig trenches as fast as troops can occupy them.

claims.quote: Submarine boats submerged for days will be capable of wiping a whole navy off the tace of the deep.
claims.description: Submarines able to stay underwater for days are predicted to destroy an entire navy.

claims.quote: Balloons and flying machines will carry telescopes of one-hundred-mile vision with camera attachments, photographing an enemy within that radius.
claims.description: Aircraft with long-range telescopic cameras are predicted to photograph enemy forces a hundred miles away.

claims.quote: Rifles will use silent cartridges.
claims.description: Firearms are predicted to fire without noise.

claims.quote: Persons and things of all kinds will be brought within focus of cameras connected electrically with screens at opposite ends of circuits, thousands of miles at a span.
claims.description: Live images of people and events thousands of miles away are predicted to appear on screens through electrically linked cameras.

claims.quote: Wireless telephone and telegraph circuits will span the world.
claims.description: Radio telephone and telegraph links are predicted to connect every part of the world.

claims.quote: A husband in the middle of the Atlantic will be able to converse with his wife sitting in her boudoir in Chicago.
claims.description: Ship passengers in mid-ocean are predicted to hold voice conversations with people on land.

claims.quote: Grand Opera will be Telephoned to private homes, and will sound as harmonious as though enjoyed from a theatre box.
claims.description: Live opera performances are predicted to be broadcast by telephone into homes.

claims.quote: The piano will be capable of changing its tone from cheerful to sad.
claims.description: Pianos are predicted to change their tone to match the mood of the music.

claims.quote: A university education will be free to every man and woman.
claims.description: Public universities are predicted to offer free tuition to all adults.

claims.quote: Pneumatic tubes, instead of store wagons, will deliver packages and bundles.
claims.description: Store purchases are predicted to be delivered to homes through pneumatic tubes instead of delivery wagons.

claims.quote: Winter will be turned into summer and night into day by the farmer.
claims.description: Farmers are predicted to control the climate of their fields with electric heat and light.

claims.quote: Electric currents applied to the soil will make valuable plants grow larger and faster, and will kill troublesome weeds.
claims.description: Electric current through soil is predicted to speed plant growth and kill weeds.

claims.quote: Delicious oranges will be grown in the suburbs of Philadelphia.
claims.description: Tropical oranges are predicted to be grown outdoors near Philadelphia.

claims.quote: Strawberries as Large as Apples will be eaten by our great-great-grandchildren for their Christmas dinners a hundred years hence.
claims.description: Strawberries are predicted to grow as large as apples.

claims.quote: Melons, cherries, grapes, plums, apples, pears, peaches and all berries will be seedless.
claims.description: Most fruits are predicted to be bred without seeds.

claims.quote: Cane will once more be the chief source of our sugar supply.
claims.description: Sugar cane is predicted to again supply most American sugar.

claims.quote: The milkweed will have been developed into a rubber plant.
claims.description: Milkweed is predicted to be bred into a plant that yields commercial rubber.

claims.quote: Plants will be made proof against disease microbes just as readily as man is to-day against smallpox.
claims.description: Crops are predicted to be made immune to disease microbes through biological engineering.

claims.quote: There will be black, blue and green roses.
claims.description: Roses in black, blue and green colors are predicted to be bred.

claims.quote: Drugs needed by the lungs, for instance, will be applied directly to those organs through the skin and flesh.
claims.description: Drugs are predicted to reach internal organs through electric current applied to the skin.

claims.quote: The living body will to all medical purposes be transparent.
claims.description: Living bodies are predicted to be made see-through for medical viewing.

claims.quote: Not only will it be possible for a physician to actually see a living, throbbing heart inside the chest, but he will be able to magnify and photograph any part of it.
claims.description: Doctors are predicted to view and photograph a beating heart inside the living chest.

claims.quote: Cattle and sheep will have no horns.
claims.description: Livestock are predicted to be bred without horns.
